bib.title: DIALOGPT: Large-Scale Generative Pre-training for Conversational Response Generation
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (System Demonstrations), pages 270-278

question: Can a GPT-2-style transformer trained on Reddit conversation chains generate relevant, informative, human-like open-domain dialogue responses, and can it be released as a tunable pre-trained model?
hypothesis: Training an autoregressive transformer on large-scale dialogue sessions lets it capture the joint distribution P(Target, Source) of conversational flow at finer granularity, giving more relevant, contentful and context-consistent responses than strong baselines.
contributions: DialoGPT, a GPT-2-based model pre-trained on 147M Reddit conversation exchanges, in 117M, 345M and 762M sizes
Open-source training pipeline (data extraction/preparation, training, evaluation) and released pre-trained model
Evaluation on DSTC-7 and a new 6K multi-reference Reddit test set, automatic and human
MMI reranking with a backward model to reduce bland responses

method.summary: GPT-2 architecture trained (from scratch or initialised from GPT-2) as a language model on Reddit reply-chain paths, with all turns concatenated into one text ended by end-of-text. Optional MMI reranking: sample 16 hypotheses with top-K (K=10) and pick the one with lowest loss under a backward P(Source|Hypothesis) model.
method.task: open-domain multi-turn conversational response generation (autoregressive LM pre-training on dialogue)

datasets.name: Reddit comment chains 2005-2017
datasets.split: inferred: validation loss used for selection and early stopping; split sizes not stated
datasets.source: scraped Reddit comment chains; each root-to-leaf path is one instance
datasets.preprocessing: Removed instances with: URL in source/target; target with word repetitions of at least three words; response lacking any top-50 frequent English word; response with '[' or ']'; source+target longer than 200 words; offensive target by blocklist phrase matching; also excluded offensive-prone subreddits; blandness filter removing responses where 90% of tri-grams were seen more than 1000 times (about 1% of data).

datasets.name: DSTC-7 multi-reference test
datasets.split: test; sessions with 6 or more responses; one of 6 human responses held out as 'Human'
datasets.source: DSTC-7 test data, Reddit threads (Galley et al. 2019)
datasets.preprocessing: further filtering such as turn length; test period differs from training span

datasets.name: Reddit 6K multi-reference test
datasets.source: new test set extracted from Reddit postings

models.name: DialoGPT 117M
models.init_from: from scratch, or OpenAI GPT-2 (both reported)

models.name: DialoGPT 345M
models.init_from: from scratch, or OpenAI GPT-2 medium

models.name: PersonalityChat
models.architecture: in-house seq2seq model based on Li et al. 2016a, trained on Twitter data

models.name: Backward model (MMI)
models.architecture: GPT-2 medium fine-tuned to predict source from response

training.objective: autoregressive LM; p(T|S)=prod_{n=m+1..N} p(x_n|x_1..x_{n-1}) over turns concatenated into one text ended by end-of-text
training.lr: selected on validation loss; value not stated
training.batch_size: per GPU 128 (117M), 64 (345M), 32 (762M); dynamic batching grouping similar-length conversations
training.epochs: up to 5 (small and medium); at most 3 (large); until no progress in validation loss
training.seq_len: inferred: source+target under 200 words after filtering

other.speedups: data compressed into a lazy-loading database file, asynchronous data processes, training time declines approximately linearly with number of GPUs
other.rl_attempt: policy gradient on R=P(Source|Hypothesis) with sample-averaged baseline converged to a degenerate parroting model (hypothesis repeats the source); abandoned
other.finetune_note: conclusion says pre-trained models can be fine-tuned on a moderately-sized dataset in few hours

inference.decoding: greedy, beam search (width 10), top-K sampling (K=10) for MMI candidates and for the shown examples
inference.samples: MMI: 16 samples per source, reranked by lowest backward-model loss
inference.prompting: dialogue history concatenated as the source; no prompt template

other.generation_code: not released because of occasional toxic outputs; model-only release

metrics.name: NIST (N-2, N-4)
metrics.definition: BLEU variant weighting n-gram matches by information gain

metrics.name: Dist-n (D-1, D-2)
metrics.definition: distinct n-gram ratio, Li et al. 2016a

metrics.name: Human pairwise preference
metrics.definition: 3 crowd judges rank system pairs on relevance, informativeness, human-likeness on a 3-point Likert-like scale

eval.protocol: 2000 randomly sampled sources from Reddit 6K; each system pair shown to 3 judges; judges passed a qualification test with spam detection; significance by 10K bootstrap iterations, alpha 0.05 (Appendix A). Single runs, no seeds stated.

evidence.quote: We used the Noam learning rate scheduler with 16000 warm-up steps.

results.claim: DialoGPT is trained on about 147M dialogue instances.
results.quote: dialogue instances, in total 1.8 billion words.

results.claim: On the Reddit 6K set, DialoGPT 345M from GPT-2 with beam search scores 21.76% BLEU-2 versus human 17.90%.
results.setup: Reddit 6K multi-reference, 345M initialised from GPT-2, beam search
results.table: Table 3, row DialoGPT (345M, Beam) under Training from OpenAI GPT-2, column B-2

results.claim: On DSTC-7 (2208 refs x5), DialoGPT 345M with beam search reaches BLEU-4 6.05% versus Team B 1.83% and held-out human 3.13%.
results.setup: DSTC-7 5-reference test, 345M, beam 10, fine-tuned without grounding

results.claim: DSTC-7 test set built from sessions with 6+ responses has 2208 instances.
results.quote: yields a 5-reference test set of size 2208.

results.claim: Beam search sharply raises DSTC Dist-2 for 345M (39.7% to 51.0%).
Initialising 117M from GPT-2 helps much more than for large models: Reddit 6K BLEU-4 1.77% from scratch vs 1.55% GPT-2 init, but NIST-2 1.23 vs 2.39.
results.note: BLEU-4 does not improve (1.77% scratch vs 1.55% GPT-2 init); paper says GPT-2 init gives larger gains for smaller models
results.table: Table 3, row DialoGPT (117M) under Training from OpenAI GPT-2, column N-2

results.claim: MMI reranking (345M) raises METEOR and diversity but lowers BLEU relative to greedy on Reddit 6K.
results.setup: Reddit 6K, 16 top-K samples (K=10) reranked by 345M backward model
results.table: Table 3, row DIALOGPT (345M, MMI), column E-4 and METEOR 11.23%

results.claim: In human eval, judges preferred DialoGPT 345M over PersonalityChat for relevance in 72% of judgements.
results.setup: 2000 sampled Reddit 6K sources, 3 judges per pair
results.table: Table 7, Relevance, row DialoGPT (345M) vs PersonalityChat, 3281 (72%)

results.claim: Judges preferred 345M with MMI over human responses in relevance (48% vs 43%) and informativeness.
results.note: Printed row alignment: System A column 2871 (48%) and System B column 2607 (43%); starred significance *** for relevance. Authors attribute to erratic human responses and memes.
results.table: Table 7, Relevance, row Human response vs DialoGPT (345M, w/ MMI), 2871 (48%)

results.claim: Plain DialoGPT 345M vs human response is not significantly different on relevance (p=0.0552) and DialoGPT 345M vs 762M is not significant.
results.table: Table 8, row 2 vs 1 Relevance, column P-Value

results.claim: RL (policy gradient on backward likelihood) with the transformer converged to a parroting degenerate solution.
results.quote: easily converges to a degenerate locally-optimal solution,

limits: Released as a model only; users must implement the decoder; generation code withheld due to occasional toxic outputs
Retains potential for offensive output and reflects gender and historical biases; may agree with unethical statements
Automatic scores exceed human scores, which the authors attribute to the one-to-many nature of conversation, not to 'realistic' quality
Judge spam-detection data may have biased results toward extremes
Optimizer, learning rate, seeds, context length, heads, dropout and wall-clock not stated; single runs
RL optimisation of mutual information failed; regularised RL left to future work
Only single-turn evaluation in the quantitative results; multi-turn claims rest on examples (Tables 4-6)

terms.definition: generate hypotheses with top-K sampling, then rerank by P(Source|Hypothesis) from a pre-trained backward model, penalising bland responses

lineage.work: Language models are unsupervised multitask learners (GPT-2)
A diversity-promoting objective function for neural conversation models
Generating informative and diverse conversational responses via adversarial information maximization
Grounded response generation task at DSTC7

figures.why: Shows why model BLEU can exceed held-out human BLEU: output sits near the centre of valid responses.
